predecessors.name: Lelang Commandery
predecessors.text: Daifang, 'located around Hwanghae' (Daifang page), cut from the southern half of Lelang

successors.name: Goguryeo
successors.text: Daifang, 'located around Hwanghae' (Daifang page), cut from the southern half of Lelang

ledger.x: 204: Gongsun Kang cuts Daifang from Lelang's southern half.
238: Daifang passes from the Gongsun to Cao Wei.

wars.name: Goguryeo-Wei War
wars.outcome: Cao Wei victory; Gong Zun, grand administrator of Daifang, marched south with Liu Mao of Lelang through the Seven Counties of Lingdong and six counties submitted; afterwards the Ye and Okjeo tributaries returned to the influence of Lelang and Daifang.

wars.name: Goguryeo conquest of Lelang and Daifang
wars.outcome: Goguryeo under Micheon takes Lelang (313) and Daifang (314).

certainty.note: The page gives seven counties, a region ('around Hwanghae') and an unresolved seat; no boundary.
